ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, within $\triangle ABC$, $AB=6$, $AC=5$, $BC=3$. Point $M$ is on $AB$ with $AM=2$. A line $MN$ intersects $\triangle ABC$ at point $M$, and it satisfies $\angle AMN = \angle C$. What is the length of $MN$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textit{Solution}: In triangles $\triangle AMN$ and $\triangle ACB$,\\
$\because$ $\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle AMN=\angle C \\
\angle MAN=\angle CAB
\end{array}\right.$ \\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AMN\sim \triangle ACB$ \\
$\therefore$ $\frac{MN}{BC}=\frac{AM}{AC}$ \\
$\therefore$ $\frac{MN}{3}=\frac{2}{5}$ \\
$\therefore$ $MN=\boxed{\frac{6}{5}}$
